title: Smarter top/bottom fade + link popup follows your cursor
summary: On the Calendar page, the top fade-under-the-navbar effect now starts below the Month/Week/Day/Agenda selector bar instead of right under the top nav pill, so that bar stays fully visible instead of getting dimmed along with scrolling content.
Added a matching fade-in effect at the bottom edge of the screen for a more polished, symmetric scroll feel.
The class links popup (the little link-count badge on a class card) now opens right next to your mouse instead of always snapping to the top-right corner of the card.
